nodes.label: Correlation form S (RPA ring + screened second-order exchange)
nodes.rationale: eps_c^S = eps_ring/2 + eps_2x^scr, with one Coulomb line replaced by the coupling-constant-averaged statically screened line W(q)=v(q)/eps_L — the ring's own screening, so no parameter enters: k_F and k_TF are functions of (r_s, zeta) alone.

nodes.label: Form-S gates G-S1 to G-S3
nodes.rationale: Must fail if wrong: the kappa->0 limit must reproduce E0B = 0.0241792 Ha at both zeta=0 and zeta=1 (the bare diagram's zeta-independence, FINDING-E0B), r_s->0 must collapse S to R to Z, and the reduced integral must match a brute 9-D Monte Carlo at two single points with no scan.
